project_type: Monorepo (pnpm workspace) - LINE Bot with AI homework generator, TypeScript Lambda + Python Agent + CDK infra
build_system: pnpm workspace with corepack. Node.js available at /opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v20.20.2/bin
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm typecheck to ensure no type errors. 2. Run pnpm test to ensure all tests pass.
setup_instructions: export PATH=/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v20.20.2/bin:$PATH && cd /projects/sandbox/homework-print-bot && corepack enable pnpm && pnpm install
environment_constraints: Node.js 20 is at /opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v20.20.2/bin (must be added to PATH). pnpm available via corepack. No Docker daemon available for building. Network mode allows package installation from registries.
contribution_requirements: CI runs pnpm typecheck. Tests use vitest with mocking.
key_patterns: Renderer Lambda: packages/functions/src/renderer/index.ts uses Puppeteer + @sparticuz/chromium. CDK bundling in packages/infra/lib/constructs/renderer.ts uses nodejs.NodejsFunction with nodeModules for chromium/puppeteer. Tests mock S3 and Puppeteer thoroughly.
directory_structure: packages/functions/src/renderer/ - the Lambda handler for HTML-to-PNG conversion. packages/infra/lib/constructs/renderer.ts - CDK construct defining the Lambda with bundling config.
